answer: Delayed beacon slot assignment makes each applicant commit a sealed bid and an umber color tag before a future verifiable random beacon is published. The beacon then maps tags to a walnut-coded queue, revealing no favorable slot in advance. Only applicants assigned to an open ledge can register; clones must each pay the full bid and wait the next beacon. Sybil cost is each extra identity's lost bid plus the wait, because assignments cannot be precomputed.
